tidbit: Did you know… about 14,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic has launched a Cyber Verification Program for Claude access. Confirmed by TechJuice, the expansion includes three tiers for vulnerability discovery and patching.
Mistral has introduced Chonk, a large open-weight model trained on 4,000 Nvidia chips and 160 languages. Confirmed by Malay Mail, the model gives clients full control over their data.
Mistral's boss says the UAE has very powerful cyber defences to repel attacks. Reported by The National, the company is considering a data centre investment there.
Rohit Prasad, an Amazon veteran, has been named CEO of Boston Dynamics. Confirmed by The Korea Herald, he will drive artificial intelligence powered robot commercialization.
OpenAI leads artificial intelligence spending in 47 states. Reported by Business Insider, Anthropic appears in three states and the District of Columbia.
Free every hour.
